panels.description:
Distribution of longitudinal acceleration values across all drives.
Computed from consecutive speed readings in drive telemetry.
Taller bars at higher absolute g values indicate more aggressive driving.
Green = mild (< 0.2g), yellow = moderate, red = aggressive (> 0.3g).

targets.rawSql:
WITH readings AS (
  SELECT
    dtr.drive_id,
    dtr.speed,
    dtr.created_at,
    LAG(dtr.speed)      OVER (PARTITION BY dtr.drive_id ORDER BY dtr.created_at) AS prev_speed,
    LAG(dtr.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY dtr.drive_id ORDER BY dtr.created_at) AS prev_time
  FROM drive_telemetry_readings dtr
  JOIN drives d ON d.id = dtr.drive_id
  WHERE d.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND dtr.speed IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    CAST(
      ((speed - prev_speed) * 0.44704)
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - prev_time)), 0)
      / 9.81
    AS numeric),
  4) AS "Acceleration (g)"
FROM readings
WHERE prev_speed IS NOT NULL
  AND prev_time IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - prev_time)) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
  AND ABS(
    ((speed - prev_speed) * 0.44704)
    / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - prev_time)), 0)
    / 9.81
  ) <= 0.5

panels.title: Acceleration Distribution

panels.description:
Summary statistics for acceleration across all drives in the selected time range.
Shows mean, standard deviation, and percentile values to quantify driving aggressiveness.

targets.rawSql:
WITH readings AS (
  SELECT
    dtr.speed,
    dtr.created_at,
    LAG(dtr.speed)      OVER (PARTITION BY dtr.drive_id ORDER BY dtr.created_at) AS prev_speed,
    LAG(dtr.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY dtr.drive_id ORDER BY dtr.created_at) AS prev_time
  FROM drive_telemetry_readings dtr
  JOIN drives d ON d.id = dtr.drive_id
  WHERE d.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND dtr.speed IS NOT NULL
),
accel AS (
  SELECT
    ((speed - prev_speed) * 0.44704)
    / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - prev_time)), 0)
    / 9.81 AS g
  FROM readings
  WHERE prev_speed IS NOT NULL
    AND prev_time IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - prev_time)) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
    AND ABS(
      ((speed - prev_speed) * 0.44704)
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - prev_time)), 0)
      / 9.81
    ) <= 0.5
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(ABS(g))::numeric, 3) AS "Mean |g|",
  ROUND(STDDEV(g)::numeric, 3) AS "Std Dev (g)",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ABS(g))::numeric, 3) AS "P95 |g|",
  ROUND(MAX(ABS(g))::numeric, 3) AS "Peak |g|",
  COUNT(*) AS "Samples"
FROM accel

panels.title: Acceleration Statistics

panels.description: Tracks braking intensity per drive over time. Hard braking events indicate aggressive driving or emergency situations.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  d.start_date AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dt.acceleration_gs < -0.3) AS "Hard Brakes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dt.acceleration_gs < -0.2 AND dt.acceleration_gs >= -0.3) AS "Moderate Brakes",
  ROUND(AVG(dt.acceleration_gs) FILTER (WHERE dt.acceleration_gs < 0)::numeric, 3) AS "Avg Decel (g)"
FROM drive_telemetry_readings dt
JOIN drives d ON dt.drive_id = d.id
WHERE d.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
GROUP BY d.id, d.start_date
ORDER BY d.start_date
